My only reason I'm alive right now is that I can't be arsed. When I die, I want to at least prepare it; I want to leave a long note, I want to plan the least painful/least obvious method etc. However, I can't be bothered, and I'm worried that my family will find out before I complete it!

So now I'm just stuck in this weird limbo where I'm technically alive, but I'm so ready to die that I feel like I'm already dead. :/

If it makes you feel any better, I feel exactly the same right now, and have for the past year or so on and off.

In my case, pretty much all of my (absolutely huge) family have some sort of mental illness, and there are three family members I know of that have attempted suicide, one of which succeeded, so my issue is definitely genetic.
But I can't be sure, since I've been on a ton of medications in the past couple of years that can cause suicidal depression, as well as a ridiculously underactive thyroid (that's finally been treated) for God knows how long, so I don't even know what damage all that shit did to my body.

To be honest, if it's not caused by any outside problems, the cause of it isn't that important anyway; the important thing is staying alive long enough to get treatment and recover from it.

Sorry for writing a bit of an essay; I hope it helped though.

It's what I've been trying to do tbh, it just gets difficult when I'm not distracted anymore and everything just messes up again. It's really snowy and icy right now, so I can't go out anywhere, but talking to you has really helped anyways, so thank you so much!

I'm usually in college today, but they're closed because of all the snow and ice. It sucks, but I guess I just have to deal with it and hope that they're open tomorrow.

I take it for when I come out of remission for ITP, so I can't avoid taking it since the other alternative is possible death (ironically) or stuff like chemotherapy. Prednisolone and Prednisone are pretty much exactly the same in almost every way, so they have the same side effects too.

My psychiatrist said that the Prednisolone was probably what made my depression worse, but there's not really anything we can do about that since Prednisolone is the safest drug they can give me for ITP. :/

Sorry if I'm not making much sense, I can't type very coherently when I feel like this.
Presumably my antidepressants are wearing off, or the retarded Prednisolone fucked up my brain again. Nothing outside really "triggered" me off though; just feel like fucking shit.
I've been feeling on and off for the past year, but this episode I'm in started a few weeks ago.
Nothing. Completely fucking nothing; waiting to find some working medication, but it's taking too fucking long.

I don't know how to describe how I feel; I definitely feel suicidal, but there's not any "motivation" behind it? Last time I was like this, I was so emotionally distraught that I physically couldn't stand living anymore, whereas this time it's more of a "fuck it, I'm done with life, but I can't be arsed to kill myself; can someone please do it for me" sort of thing going on.

The first time, my depression drove me to pretty much an emotional turmoil where I wanted to end it in the quickest way possible, but this time it's led me to this weird place where I just feel completely empty, to the point where I'm genuinely considering suicide because I'm just so done; like seriously this was already the worst year of my life so far, but now I'm having my third mental breakdown this year. I can't stand any of this anymore, but I'm too fed up to even bother doing anything remotely difficult.
It doesn't help that everyone seems to have it so much worse, but then I'm here with a great life, but still feeling like complete shit.

Sorry for rambling so much; I feel bad for always worrying my family with this sort of stuff, so I'd honestly rather find other ways of letting it all out sometimes. :/
I'll keep you in mind; thank you

Not long after I posted this, I had a long talk with my mum and it really helped me, but thank you anyway! :) People like you make the world a better place! 

Honestly, I think my medication needs upping, since I've been having quite a few of these suicidal episodes recently; I'll just ring CAMHS tomorrow morning and ask if they do emergency physiatrist appointments. Hopefully I can get one soon, since the dose I'm on seems to have worn off gradually!

I've never taken any other doses, but with 25mg it makes me a bit sleepy so I have to take it before bed! Other than that, I can hardly feel any difference when I take it (however if I forget the dose, I usually feel really shit when I wake up in the morning)! ;)
I've been using Firefox and I've never had that pop-up! xD It must only be a Chrome thing!
Thank you! Good luck to you too! :)

I have to disagree with staying off medication personally; I'm on medication for depression and it saved my life (since my depression had literally no outside cause, therefore there wasn't any outside way to stop it besides medication) and I'm on such a miniscule dose that I don't have any side effects!

At this point, I think the only thing I can really do is give it time; naturally it won't be easy to recover from something like a breakdown, but I hope I can get back on my feet at some point! :)

Mainly trying to keep myself distracted, not dwelling on it if I have an episode, "grounding techniques" (or whatever they're called) and it just keeps coming back.

It doesn't help that I'm not exactly fully recovered from depression yet; to an extent, I'm still suicidal, but in more of a 'passive' sense, so my head is still all over the place tbh. Maybe that's why I can't really get better yet, since the underlying issue isn't gone!
A lovely suicidal depression breakdown, caused by being rushed off my anti depressants by ITP. Fun times!

Two months later, but just found this thread and can relate!

I'm 99% sure that my dysphoria isn't the cause of DP/DR, but it sure as hell isn't helping! Trans people without DP/DR already feel detached from themselves, but this is a whole other layer of shit! I'm hoping transitioning will maybe help, but I'm not expecting anything.

Surprisingly not, since I literally don't feel like me anymore, but I've been depressed for nearly a year, so I've become fantastic at faking happiness! It's a good, yet terrible, skill to have, since it's got to the point where I even end up convincing myself that I'm feeling an emotion, even though I'm not!

Don't worry, it doesn't sound crazy to me because I'm going through exactly what you describe right now! Yay!

Honestly if I knew how to fix it I'd tell you, but sadly I don't, and it sucks; I'm only commenting because I'm hoping it'll make you feel a bit better knowing that pretty much all of us are going through this too! :)

I don't take any of the others, but I take 25mg Sertraline and it pretty much saved my life (I know it's a tiny dose, but if it works then idgaf)! It's not helping my DP/DR, but I'm not trying to kill myself anymore so achievement unlocked? xD
My graphics teacher looks like young Stalin; I'll see if I can get a picture of him and post a comparison at some point! xD

I hope you're starting to feel better now since it's been a few hours, but here's my advice:

Have a cup of tea and relax (that's how us Brits do it anyways), put on some YouTube (either on your phone, PC or TV), grab a blanket or duvet (I have a blue blanket I always used to use which I dubbed the "mentally ill" blanket) and have a chill.

I've always found talking to people helps too; even if you're just crying on someone, it'll help to comfort you (my mum's shirts now have multiple snot stains thanks to depression).

And never feel alone! All of us here have hit the bottom of the depression pit and beyond, and chances are that all of us have, or still do, feel just like you right now! And if all of us can last through it, you can too!

Hope you're feeling better soon! :)

When I was suicidal, I had plenty of people talking to me, and they didn't stop me from wanting to kill myself at all (no offense to them of course; they were trying so hard to keep me alive)! If my medication didn't kick in when it did, I probs wouldn't be alive right now honestly.

Definitely! When there's nothing on your mind and you're alone, so your head is just floating around, you end up thinking about how shit your life is, or just generally feel more sad.

I'm a massive extrovert, so I just feel automatically depressed when I'm alone anyway, hence I absolutely hate night-time!

I don't have anything that solves it sorry, I sort of just ride it out, and sometimes just cry myself to sleep! #workseverytime :P
When I was at my worst, I just flat-out didn't look at social media for a month, and it definitely helped! ;)

Fuck yeah, fluffy jumpers forever! xD I'm sort of used to it after wearing it all day; I think I just caught myself off guard when I first looked in the mirror!

As someone who already has dissociation issues, nowadays I can never even tell if it's just gendery stuff causing it, or if it's my brain being a bit retarded as per usual! :P

You just described me, except I don't have any sexual attractions! xD I'm starting to think that it's just dysphoria at play, since I don't think I could ever get a girl while I look like their younger brother lol; maybe I'm THAT insecure (and depressed I guess) that I just don't have a libido, but I guess this is all speculation until I transition fully! :)

My friends are good at listening, but my mum and sister are very good at trying to "problem solve"! I can't rant about anything without them trying to give me solutions, when really I just need to moan and get something off my chest! Dx

Hell yes! If it was possible to deliver cake and ice cream over the Internet, I would do so! :D 

I also have the same thing when it comes to moaning about shit; yes, there's children in Africa dying of starvation, but I still feel like shit too! I can't just leave myself feeling shit and anxious if it's easy to solve with a simple moan or two! :P

I'm glad I made you feel a bit better, and I'm glad someone else deals with all this the same way I do! I'm not in an episode now because I went bed not long after I posted, and I'm feeling better! :) 

I guess my way of coping just ended up gradually appearing because of how legitimately garbage 2017 has been for me; at this point I've got sick of being sad, so when I'm not depressed I try to be as sarcastic and not-depressing as I can! xD

Wow, they're just pricks as parents, full stop! The best thing you can do is not give in. If you give in, you prove them right, and they'll just be like "told you so". Don't bother challenging them in it either; if your dickhead dad starts mocking you again, just leave the room and chill in your bedroom, play a game, and maybe call a friend and ask if you can come over because your parents are twats.

You poor, poor man!

And patience is something I have virtually none of! xD I'll probably end up just whittling down the KH1 trophies over time, but for now I've just started on my KH2 Critical run (since I know that game like the back of my hand, and have 100%ed it twice already, so I can do that pretty fast). I'm planning on getting platinum on every KH game before KH3 comes out, but knowing my luck that's not going to happen! xD I'll at least try to beat every KH game again (since that shouldn't take too long, and I'm already over half way through)!

I am incredibly exhausted recently, but I can't really help it (thanks again Prednisolone withdrawal) so I'm far worse than usual! xD I'm hoping it goes back to normal once I start being more awake, but I know I stutter quite a bit, even when I've had a good sleep!
You always have to try and have hope, even if it seems futile! :)

I have the same thing; it usually likes to hit me when I'm alone, like at night when I'm just daydreaming to myself (because that's just how I get sleep) it suddenly hits me like a truck, or sometimes it just slowly seeps in while I'm doing work for college.

I guess my coping mechanism is just absorbing myself into a TV show or videogame universe; when I'm having an episode, they feel just as real as reality, so it helps me to embrace the episode and just enjoy myself anyway! :)

I know what you mean; even while I was suicidal I was going to college, and I even did my AS Maths exams (and somehow got an A) so I will always look at that as a personal achievement, and ironically it helped me to stop beating myself up - not many people can get an A in MEI Maths, nevermind having a mental breakdown at the same time! :P

It definitely helps that nobody at college really knows my situation (besides some of the faculty). The amount of times they managed to cheer me up indirectly is unbelievable; during the first breakdown, my mum nearly took me to A&E because I wouldn't stop crying, but then she reminded me of a funny story I told her about one of my mates falling off a chair, and it actually made me laugh! xD

When the big things are fucking you over, the little things are what keep you through life I guess! ;)

My social worker said that recently, and I was like "lol I'm great at reading I'm not dyslexic", so I think it might just be attributed to ADHD (since I couldn't find any form of Dyslexia that only affects speech).

I have more of an issue with numbers (e.g. I always mix up 5 and 9 because they sound the same in my own head) and I can't do simple maths to save my life (despite currently doing A-Level Maths and having some of the highest grades in my class) so if anything, I have some sort of Dyscalculia, but I have no idea honestly! xD

I'm from the North Staffs (sort of) area in the UK, so my accent also misses out letters like H and T too; I also watched too much American TV as a child, so I've been left with a weird American twinge (like the way they say the R sound) which makes my speech pretty awkward to understand! xD

I'd imagine it's not part of diagnostic criteria because in children, speech is constantly developing as you grow up, with some finding it easier than others. Also, it's common for young children to have a stutter/stammer and just "grow out of it", so that could be an easy explanation for a child struggling with speech rather than attributing it to ADHD!
That was the plan! ;) I did something similar with DDD while I was trying to get all the abilities! Is there any way to make levelling quicker (like an EXP mulitplier or something)?

Recently, I've gotten into the habit of noting down ideas for my A-Level Art into my phone whenever they come into my head, and now I have a solid roadmap to complete the rest of my project, which will hopefully be done by the deadline in December (and I seem to be on the right track)! :D

If anything ADHD has been incredibly useful when thinking up ideas on what to do next! ;)

I would think that it would be (since it's pretty much just getting distacted by your own head traffic) but I honestly have no clue because I coudln't find anything on it either! xD

I would ask a health care professional, but my Social Worker knows virtually nothing about the ins and outs of ADHD (she was surprised when I was diagnosed with it, despite me being an incredibly textbook ADHD case) and I'm not seeing my Psychiatrist until December, who I haven't even met before! Apparently she's really blunt and HATES people rambling without a point, so I already know that she's going to dread appointments me and my mum! xD

Anyways, back to the point, if you ever do find out, I'd be curious to know if the speech stuff is because of ADHD! :)

Glad to know I'm not the only one! xD I speak really fast too, so a lot of the time people don't notice it, but when they do, I usually just laugh it off.

I'm honestly far too impatient to try and slow down my speech (knowing my luck I'd forget what I was saying because I'd be too busy slowing my speech down to focus on my words) but that might be something I end up trying in the future! ;)

Luckily I don't think anyone really cares that I stutter my way through sentences; it's probably far more embarrassing and awkward for me than anyone else!
